description: The figure is a pie chart representing a breakdown of two categories related to the paper’s context, showing a total of 2 slices. The larger slice is labeled “Reduction,” colored orange, and is annotated inside the slice with “60.9s (69.92%),” indicating it accounts for roughly 70% of the total. The smaller slice is labeled “Efficient deployment,” colored blue, and is annotated with “26.2s,” corresponding to the remaining roughly 30% (the percentage is not explicitly printed for this slice). The chart places labels near the slices and includes numeric annotations within the slices; there is no separate legend. The blue “Efficient deployment” slice appears slightly separated from the rest (exploded/offset), visually emphasizing it.
